name: henri-2
prompt: The attached images are STYLE references only (classic Korean MMORPG pixel art). For more of that style, browse these two games and study their character sprites: 바람의나라: 연 https://baramy.nexon.com/ and 도깨비의세계 https://dokkaebi.kakaogames.com/preregister/ . Learn from them: thick dark outlines, dithered shading, saturated but limited palette, about 4 heads tall with a large head and voluminous hair, slight 3/4 top-down view. If my previous character image (the young painter in the jade-green robe) is in this conversation, keep that exact character - same colors, proportions, hair, outline - and change ONLY the three things marked CHANGE below. Otherwise draw him fresh from this description. The character: a young court painter (도화서 화원) of a Joseon-fantasy world, 29 years old, French - light chestnut-brown hair, slightly wavy, tied up in a small topknot with a black horsehair headband (망건) and NO hat, fair skin, thin eyebrows, a relaxed faint smile. CHANGE 1: no glasses - draw the eyes open and clearly visible, two dark eyes like the reference sprites. CHANGE 2: the ink brush tucked behind his right ear must read as a brush - a dark red-brown handle sticking out sideways past the hair, with a small white bristle tip at the end. CHANGE 3: in his left hand, held flat against his chest, a clearly rectangular sketchbook (화첩) - a pale cream cover with a dark brown spine on one edge, about as wide as his torso; not a scroll, not a bundle. Clothing: a jade-green dopo robe (밝은 옥색, not blue) with a plum-purple belt cord (세조대) tied at the waist with two hanging tails, over a white hanbok, white pants, black flat shoes; his right hand hangs down loosely. Requirements: one character, full body, idle pose, facing the viewer (south), centered on a flat solid magenta background (#FF00FF), no drop shadow, no text, no border, no scenery. Render as crisp pixel art exactly 48 pixels tall (head to feet, fitting inside a 32x48 logical cell), then upscale exactly 8x with nearest-neighbor so every pixel is a sharp 8x8 block on a 384x384 canvas.
